name: NOIRE
summary: Dark-first lakeside grand hotel site in ink and bone with a hairline Boska serif, a giant wordmark tucked behind the hero landscape, numbered chapters and scroll-pinned room and experience stages.

fonts.pairing: light 300 high-contrast serif with italic emphasis for display, numerals and quotes; Satoshi for body and widely tracked uppercase labels

signature: oversized hairline wordmark layered behind a cut-out mountain horizon in the hero
numbered chapter eyebrows (01 to 06) with a short champagne rule before each label
hand-drawn style lake map beside a distance table of nearby places
booking bar in a ruled strip at the foot of the hero with a bone-coloured action block
imagery: dusk and blue-hour lake landscapes, villa terraces, sunlit breakfast tables, warm interiors; desaturated cinematic grade
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, 80px side padding, 160px section padding, asymmetric 1/3 label column and 2/3 content column, zero radius
